decisionSummary: The current direct Claude release objective supersedes the historical 32-app pre-launch planning cut for this one onboarding. Selected Claude-Melusina 0.1.0/appVersion 1 from the canonical dev-publish cut after the release-hardening work: Go 1.25.13, bounded atomic runtime staging, and a session-only direct Anthropic credential proxy. main and dev-publish point to the same reviewed commit, so this direct-dev selection adds no divergent source line. The source is eligible for a governed candidate only; this record does not claim a package, on-chain release, public pointer, tenant install, or provider response exists.

checks: clean detached recursive checkout at the selected commit; origin main and dev-publish advertise the exact same source
candidate-preflight passed on the selected source: CI, race suite, module verification, and govulncheck
two independent clean GitHub clones at different paths produced byte-identical signed SPKs under the pinned Go toolchain
runtime installer regression coverage exercises cumulative upload bounds, atomic staging and swap, tar containment, and malformed archive refusal
credential proxy regression coverage proves a direct key stays memory-only and Claude receives only a per-process proxy token
receipt generated from git ls-remote at selection time rather than hand-transcribed
